decisions.reason: Quantified success and a dedicated webpage signal high sunk investment and public commitment, making escalation strongly favor keeping.
Its own webpage indicates visible commitment and investment, and the lack of results is still attributable to temporary causes, so management keeps it.
Only a website mention implies little investment and weak public commitment, so escalation pressure is low and dropping is likely.
Limited web presence suggests minimal sunk costs and no strong public justification, making withdrawal easier under the theory.
Being merely mentioned indicates low commitment and investment, so escalation does not strongly justify keeping it.
A dedicated webpage reflects significant public commitment and sunk investment, so escalation favors retention.
